C-VV-VERIFICATION-SKILL.IntentSummary: Add the vv-verification managed skill as one language-agnostic decision workflow plus six on-demand references, make vv-spec and vv-plan demand verification intent inside their existing fields, register the skill through MANAGED_SKILL_NAMES, update the exact install/sync surface counts, document it in README, and synchronize the owning GRACE projections.

MustPassCommand.Command: bun test src/lib/managed-skills.test.ts src/lib/opencode.test.ts src/lib/spec-lint.test.ts src/commands/lint.test.ts

T-001.Title: Write the vv-verification skill body and its six references.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: SKILL.md has YAML frontmatter with name vv-verification and a discovery description covering tests, oracles, evidence, and formal verification; the body carries the claim-to-evidence workflow, risk classification, oracle selection, evidence ledger, hard stops, language rule, and reference routing.

strategy.md, oracles.md, evidence.md, formal.md, and maintenance.md carry their stable heading anchors and remain language-agnostic, with no framework mandate and no bundled script. create-your-verification-stack.md carries its stable heading anchors (Write VERIFICATION.md, Create the verification CLI, Generate the project skills, Register the skills, Never impose a framework) and teaches generating VERIFICATION.md, a thin CLI wrapper in the repository's own runner, and the project-local verify and maintain-verification skills at the repository's skill convention with approval-gated registration.

The content is principle-based: it avoids empirical statistics, named studies, vendors, people, and internal source pointers; contested claims are labeled; differential and metamorphic oracles are marked as general testing theory.

T-002.Title: Require verification intent in vv-spec and vv-plan without changing XML contracts.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: vv-spec testing.strategy and testing.coverage guidance requires material claims, oracles, evidence artifacts, residual risks, and deliberate non-coverage; the spec template comments explain the expectation and add no element.

vv-plan acceptance and verification guidance requires a named property and oracle per criterion and inspectable evidence per command; the plan template comments explain the expectation and add no element.
src/lib/spec-lint.test.ts and src/commands/lint.test.ts still pass over the shipped templates.

T-003.Title: Register vv-verification, extend contract tests, and pin the install/sync surface.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: MANAGED_SKILL_NAMES contains vv-verification exactly once; loader, path, install, and reference-discovery logic are unchanged.
managed-skills.test.ts asserts registration, frontmatter, decision-workflow markers, the exact sorted six-reference list, every reference anchor, and vv-spec/vv-plan verification-intent delivery.

opencode.test.ts pins the 33-file install/sync surface, the 31-file vv-spec-skip case, and vv-verification sample paths; edited module contracts, maps, and change summaries remain accurate and paired.

T-004.Title: Document the skill, synchronize GRACE, and run the integrated gate.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: README lists vv-verification with its trigger and deliverables and marks it additive; M-CLI-MANAGED-SKILLS and V-M-CLI-MANAGED-SKILLS describe the skill, its six references, and the spec/plan integration.
The full gate passes with fresh output, including bun run check, bun run build, bun run pack:check, vvoc lint, grace lint, and grace status.
The diff contains only approved implementation, template, test, documentation, and lifecycle files, with no generated dist edit and a clean git diff --check.
